description: Returns evenly spaced price points across one market, oldest first. Use it to see the shape of a market without paging through snapshots. It splits the market window, or the part of it inside start_time and end_time, into samples equal buckets and returns the first snapshot of each bucket. Each point has time, spot_price, price_up, and price_down. empty_buckets counts the buckets with no snapshot, and note says where the data ends when the last buckets are empty. For a market still running, the range stops at the current time. Costs 1 + samples API requests, which is 21 with the default. The result is complete and has no paging. For more detail, raise samples or call polytest_get_snapshots on a short range.

end_time.description: ISO 8601. End of the range. Defaults to the market end. No zone means UTC.

market_id.description: PolyTest market id from polytest_list_markets or polytest_get_market.

samples.description: Number of buckets. Each one costs 1 API request.

start_time.description: ISO 8601. Start of the range. Defaults to the market start. No zone means UTC.

name: polytest_get_price_series

bucket_seconds.description: Length of each bucket in seconds.

price_down.description: Lowest ask on the Down order book, 0 to 1: what buying Down cost at that moment. Null when nobody was selling Down. Up and Down asks usually add up to a little more than 1.

price_up.description: Lowest ask on the Up order book, 0 to 1: what buying Up cost at that moment. Null when nobody was selling Up.

requests_used.description: API requests this call made, retries included.

title: Get price series
